stem.x: In the UML data model shown in the figure below, which of the following is a multiplicity that should be inserted in blanks I and II?
(1)  One or more employees belong to a department.
(2)  An employee belongs to any one department.
(3)  The history of the departments to which an employee has belonged is recorded as the assignment history.

stem.alt: UML class diagram with three classes in a row. Left: Department (attributes: Department code, Department name, ⋮). Middle: Assignment history (attributes: Start date, End date, ⋮). Right: Employee (attributes: Employee code, Name, ⋮). Department is associated with Assignment history: multiplicity 1 at the Department end and blank I at the Assignment history end.
